american_prospect.title: Michigan’s Mike Rogers Got Big Payout Before Controversial Cybersecurity Firm Went Bankrupt
reported_claims: American Prospect/CMD says filings show IronNet paid former Rep. Mike Rogers nearly $724,887 before its 2023 Chapter 11; story rounds to $725,000.

It reports a six-figure secured note, a 2023 financial-disclosure value in the $100,000–$1,000,000 range for IronNet capital gains, and a $557,883 secured claim still reflected in a Sep. 22, 2026 court document despite disappearing from a July 2026 statement.

primary_checks.fact: IronNet's Dec. 2022 8-K lists Michael J. Rogers among eight lenders to $6.9m aggregate secured notes bearing 13.8% annual interest; does not give his individual principal.

Stretto-hosted IronNet bankruptcy Doc. 142 (filed 2023-11-17) contains a proof of claim naming Rogers, $557,883.35, debt date 2022-12-14, and secured-note/UCC-lien basis. This verifies the filed claim then, not that the same balance remained outstanding in Sep. 2026.
Official House Clerk 2023 disclosure PDF located and captured (HTTP 200), but is image-only to available local text extraction; income/capital-gain bracket not independently verified here.

american_prospect.limits: The payment total, 2026 statement comparison, and alleged current claim status remain Prospect/CMD reporting in this capture; public Stretto portal did not expose a current claim row. Article is about financial ties/claim status, not a new IronNet bankruptcy or a new Michigan poll. startupfortune.title: Stripe buys OpenRouter for 7.5 billion and the pipe stops being neutral
startupfortune.alert_body_binding: Not conclusively established. The public Google News alert link resolved only to Google's consent page in this bounded check. The captured StartupFortune page is related context: same publisher, topic, and $7.5bn claim, but its captured page title is 'Stripe Agrees to Buy AI Model Router OpenRouter for $7.5 Billion', which does not contain the alert's 'pipe stops being neutral' wording. Do not treat it as verified exact alert body.
startupfortune.reported_claim: StartupFortune says Stripe agreed to acquire OpenRouter for about $7.5bn, attributing the figure to NYT and saying Bloomberg/Axios corroborated; article notes estimates above $7bn and $8bn. Its neutrality language is editorial framing, not a measured event.

official_context.fact: Stripe's Aug. 19 announcement says it agreed to acquire OpenRouter; no price or completion reported. The exact alert body remains unresolved; the related StartupFortune page is not evidence of a newly completed acquisition.

startupfortune.limits: The $7.5bn amount and completion status were not verified in an official company filing/announcement in the available captures; price is attributed secondary reporting.
